tasks.brief: A miniature arched toll gate beside a small sloping-roof guard hut. Preserve a visible clear opening beneath the arch and distinguish the hut from the gate. Give the gate a visible signal or marker. Compose the whole as a recognisable entrance, with intentional ground contacts. Use exactly 16 parts from the declared inventory maxima; unused inventory is allowed. Choose colours freely. No extra baseplate or parts outside the palette.

A miniature canal landing: a low boat approaching an arched footbridge beside a short quay. Keep visible water-space between boat and quay, and clear space above the boat under the bridge opening. The boat and shore are intentionally separate objects; suggest water with colour and empty space rather than filling a base. Use exactly 16 parts from the declared inventory maxima; unused inventory is allowed. Choose colours freely. No extra baseplate or parts outside the palette.

A miniature stepped lookout with an ascending route, a small sheltered observation perch and a distinctive sloping canopy. Make the height progression legible, preserve open space beneath the canopy, and give the upper marker a connected support. It is a static sculpture; no moving mechanism is requested. Use exactly 16 parts from the declared inventory maxima; unused inventory is allowed. Choose colours freely. No extra baseplate or parts outside the palette.

Two small stylised birds facing one another at a shared feeder. Use their head/body/beak relationships and different poses to make both birds recognisable. Preserve a gap between the birds, make each appear to reach toward the same feeder, and keep the feeder distinct from their bodies. Separate ground-supported objects are intentional. Use exactly 16 parts from the declared inventory maxima; unused inventory is allowed. Choose colours freely. No extra baseplate or parts outside the palette.
